facts.text: I am planning a trip to Japan.
I have booked a hotel in Tokyo.
I need help with my itinerary for my trip to Japan.
I am not sure what the best way is to get from the airport to my Tokyo hotel.
I was thinking of taking the train to get from the airport to my Tokyo hotel.
I have a lot of luggage.
I am considering taking a taxi because I have a lot of luggage.
I was told that taking a taxi from the airport to my hotel would cost around $60.
The $60 taxi cost is a bit pricey for me.
I was thinking of asking my hotel if they have recommendations for transportation from the airport.
